origin: Original deterministic damped-contact synthesis written for the R9 prototype; no external sample recording.
unchanged: All cues before dock at 18.1 seconds, browser tone/air/swell implementations, master and compressor settings.

dock.pcm: Two Float32 channels from AIslandIntroAudio.dockPCM(sampleRate,length,volume,settleOffset). No randomness or platform oscillator implementation.

native_status: Not rendered or copied to production. Root must render complete 22-second OfflineAudioContext using the new dock primitive plus the unchanged master gain 0.7 and compressor; then verify and update native media provenance only after user approval.
offline_excerpt: verify-r9.cjs emits a 48 kHz stereo PCM16 dock excerpt scaled by master 0.7, without compressor. It is a local audition aid, not a full/native score.
